items.fdcDescription: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Vegetable stock (or water)' to USDA SR Legacy 'Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve' through a retained exact evidence record. The destination label names vegetable stock as the primary ingredient; the parenthetical water wording is a recipe substitution/preparation alternative rather than a different stock identity. USDA's ready-to-serve vegetable broth is used as the closest exact reviewed stock/broth record. Confidence remains medium because water/salted-water/seasoned-water alternatives can have materially different sodium and nutrient values, so this binding represents the vegetable-stock branch only.
